replacements.new: 本节补上第 39.58—39.59 节的同 tick 组织来源。在本节所记录的来源阶段，第 39.61 节来源 owner／时钟与第 39.62—39.63 节 serial 人口的登记运输、整个有限世代过程的实际资源和原 P12 父身份发现，仍须真正接到同一过程；登记视图不使人口派发变成固定亲本无限部署。标记读取的额外权限和费用必须明确登记，旧 Batch 仍不能识别全局父身份。OPEN / NOT_ESTABLISHED 是该来源阶段的历史判定；后继第 39.65—39.95 节及核心总论记录其后续结算，以及现行 CLASSIFIED_CORE_CLOSED 的准确范围。上述模型限制仍然保留。
replacements.new_en: This section supplies the same-tick organizational source missing in Sections 39.58–39.59. At the source stage recorded here, the registration transport between the source owner and clock in Section 39.61 and the serial population in Sections 39.62–39.63, the actual resources of the complete finite-generation process, and original P12 parent-identity discovery still had to be connected to the same process. Registration views do not turn population dispatch into infinite deployment of a fixed parent. The extra permissions and fees for reading marks must be explicitly registered, and the old Batch still cannot identify global parent identity. The OPEN / NOT_ESTABLISHED assessment belongs to that source stage. Subsequent Sections 39.65–39.95 and the core overview record its later resolution and the scope of the current CLASSIFIED_CORE_CLOSED status; the model restrictions just stated remain in force.

replacements.new_en: This section still pays only controlled-write fees. The actual consumer that adds the full read fee $B r$ to the same initial wallet is given in Section 39.68; None and incorrect readings are not exempt. At the source stage recorded here, the correct rectangular finite-generation replacement for original P12 still required an actual connection among the owner and clock, the same returned program, actual parenthood, P5/P6, Price, the originally registered P9 evaluation, and necessary parent-identity discovery. Registration, evaluation, and sensor permissions are explicit model conditions, not synonyms for those internal derivations. The OPEN / NOT_ESTABLISHED assessment belongs to that source stage. Subsequent Sections 39.68–39.95 and the core overview record the later connections and the scope of the current CLASSIFIED_CORE_CLOSED status; the explicit model conditions remain unchanged.
